texts: Added the sitewide search feature. You can find it beside the title of the site on the header.

Added Community Trivia Quiz. There aren't many questions to start with, but hopefully the dataset will grow over time. If you'd like to contribute, you can submit your own questions for others to answer! (Login required to submit questions)
Adjusted the format of answers in Shadow Guesser.
Applied coloring based on status type to status tooltips.
